dataset.holdout_rule: evaluated only for hypotheses that pass validation; logged in the dataset ledger

bar: daily, 00:00-24:00 UTC, built from M5; decision at the daily close using data up to and including that close; position earns the NEXT day's return
direction: long or flat only (spot, no shorting, no leverage); exposure in [0, 1]

costs.applied: per unit of absolute change in exposure
costs.basis: Binance VIP 0 published fee; spread/slippage is a conservative allowance (measured ~0.001 bp)

H1_tsmom30.rule: exposure 1 if trailing 30-day log return > 0 else 0
H1_tsmom30.rationale: Time-series momentum: slow information diffusion and trend-following flows (documented for many asset classes and for crypto in the academic literature).

H2_vol_scaled_tsmom.rule: H1 sign x min(1, 0.40 / annualised 30-day realised volatility); rebalance only when target differs from current exposure by > 0.10
H2_vol_scaled_tsmom.rationale: Volatility clustering: cutting exposure when volatility is high improves risk-adjusted returns if high volatility does not bring proportionally higher returns.

H3_donchian_55_20.rule: enter (exposure 1) when the daily close exceeds the prior 55-day high; exit when the daily close falls below the prior 20-day low
H3_donchian_55_20.rationale: Volatility-expansion breakout: a range break marks the start of a trend; a classic trend-following rule with an asymmetric exit.

H4_crash_reversal.rule: after a day whose return < -2.5 x trailing 30-day daily standard deviation, exposure 1 for the next 3 days
H4_crash_reversal.rationale: Liquidity provision: forced liquidations of leveraged positions push prices below fundamental value temporarily; buyers who absorb the flow are compensated.

H5_failed_breakdown.rule: if the day's low trades below the prior 20-day low but the day closes above that level, exposure 1 for the next 5 days
H5_failed_breakdown.rationale: Breakout failure: stops below an obvious level are run and absorbed; the failure to hold the break signals exhausted selling at a horizon where moves dwarf costs.

tests.primary: timing skill: circular-shift permutation of the exposure series against daily returns (2000 shifts, minimum shift 30 days); p = share of shifts whose mean net return >= actual. Costs are path-identical under a shift, so this tests timing, not cost.
secondary: net Sharpe ratio (daily returns x sqrt(365))
comparison with buy-and-hold over the same segment
tests.multiple_testing: Holm-Bonferroni across the 5 hypotheses at family-wise alpha 0.05 on the TRAINING segment

gates.train: Holm-adjusted timing p < 0.05 AND net Sharpe > 0
gates.validation: only train survivors; timing p < 0.05 AND net Sharpe > 0 AND net total return > 0
gates.holdout: only validation survivors; net Sharpe > 0 AND net total return > 0; reported with the ledger entry

not_allowed: changing any parameter after seeing results
adding hypotheses after seeing results without counting them in the multiple-testing family
looking at validation for train failures
looking at the hold-out for validation failures
